model: Hugging Face SegformerForSemanticSegmentation, nvidia/mit-b2 ImageNet encoder, stock all-MLP decoder (1 logit at 1/4 res, bilinear upsample), 1-ch robust median/MAD+asinh norm, 1x1 conv 1->3 ch adapter, focal+dice; flip-TTA, thr 0.999 picked on val

upstream.ref: nvidia/mit-b2 weights from the HF Hub via transformers 4.57.6 SegformerForSemanticSegmentation

eval.threshold_from: scripts/val_grid.py on 400 evenly spaced VAL images: {best.pt, last.pt} x flip-TTA {off,on} x saturated mask {0,1,2} x thr .5-.999; best = best.pt + TTA, no mask, thr 0.999 (val peak F1 0.8668); log evals/h3/seg_b2_a/val_grid_test.json
eval.eval_cmd: python -m seg.evaluate --model hf_segformer --config configs/hf_segformer.yaml --ckpt /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/results/peaknet-seg-sprint/checkpoints/h3/seg_b2_a/best.pt --split test --split-json results/split/result.json --workers 6 --out /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/results/peaknet-seg-sprint/evals/h3/seg_b2_a/metrics_test.json --save-overlays /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/results/peaknet-seg-sprint/figures/h3/seg_b2_a/test --n-overlays 6 --thr 0.999 --tta

notes: Run seg_b2_a: seg.train (shared trainer), mit-b2, crop 512, 16 crops/step (4 per image), pos_frac 0.7, AdamW lr 3e-4 (encoder x0.25), cosine, focal(alpha .25,gamma 2)+dice, bf16, rot90 + gain jitter, 92 min on one L40S (shared with a second run part of the time), 10001 steps. Test = whole split (1529 imgs) at native resolution, flip-TTA (4 flips, mean prob), thr 0.999. Val (400 imgs) F1 .867 vs test .822: recall drops on the mfxl1027522_r0028 part of test. Tried: PixelShuffle(4) full-res head (worse, val .66 @1500 steps, stopped); mit-b3 + focal(alpha .75)x10+dice (val .854 peak at step 3000, stopped at ~04:00 to free the GPU for this eval); saturated-pixel masking (no gain: the robust norm already tames 65535 pixels). False positives are isolated faint spots far from true peaks (scripts/fp_diag.py), not fragments.

selection.checkpoint: seg.train best.pt (step 4000 of 10001; val sweep in-run was capped at thr 0.9) chosen over last.pt (val grid F1 0.812) by val grid
